verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Paperspace has APIs/CLI for creating and managing machines, but nothing documents a programmatic endpoint returning live GPU pricing/availability that an agent could query before committing spend; probes for an OpenAPI spec all 404, and pricing is only presented as marketing copy ('save up to 70%'), not a queryable catalog. Missing for 10: a documented pricing/availability API or endpoint, OpenAPI/schema exposing GPU catalog data, any evidence of programmatic pre-spend pricing checks.
